sheets.name: Sheet1
sheets.grain: Two interleaved row kinds: (1) species heading row (name in A only, B:G blank) and (2) one tray/lot row beneath it = one seed sowing or cutting set of that species, with source, amount, dates and survival; a few continuation rows with no code in A add a later pricking-out tally to the tray above

columns.notes: Header cell is a stale title with a date (17/11/2021). Column mixes species heading rows (binomial or genus only) with tray codes. Two code styles: legacy S<n>/C<n> (seed-lot or cutting-batch number, repeated across sowings) and S/C+YYMMDD (looks like a sow date but rarely matches column D). Some codes carry a trailing species word or trailing spaces/commas.
Seed/cutting collection place names; values withheld. Filled on tray rows only.
Seeds by volume (tsp/Tbsp/cup/fluff/heads) or cuttings by count; 485 numeric, 485 text. Not comparable across rows.
Real dates except 1 text cell. Range 2016-06-16 to 2023-10-08 in this version.
Blank where not yet pricked out or discarded. 19 text cells, 3 integers (serial numbers shown as ints). Pricked-out range 2016-10-01 to 2023-10-04.
Count pricked out/surviving (0 to ~1554); 20 text cells.
Intended as survival fraction (some typed, not formula) but also holds container notes (V150, T28, 35F) and '?' in 48 cells; fraction scale mixed (0-1 and up to 77).

Free-text notes: stratification, discards, hand-offs, container destinations (V150/PB3 with dates and counts), loss reasons. Initials and personal names appear (values withheld). One typed formula ('=+ 24.8/25') in other versions.

quality_issues.issue: Species heading rows and tray rows share column A; species is implied by position, so any extract must carry the heading forward. 125 heading rows, about 1037 coded tray rows, 63 continuation rows without a code
Species headings include genus-only entries and trailing-space variants, e.g. 'Acaena' (A2), 'Aristotelia fruticosa ' (A10)
Cross-workbook formulas to an external 2a Seed records.xls, cached as #REF! in all three cells, so source/quantity/survived for that tray are lost
Quantity sown in C is mixed units (tsp, Tbsp, cups of fluff, heads, counts, 'tiny amt'); not summable
%survival column holds container labels (V150, T28, 35F) and '?' in place of numbers; fractions and whole numbers mixed; mostly hard-typed not calculated
Non-date text in date columns (e.g. '?', two dates in one cell) and numeric serials in E
Pricked-out date before sown date on 2 rows
Title cell still reads 17/11/2021 although later sowings to Oct 2023 are present; no version date in file
Seed-lot codes S<n> repeat across sowings (same lot sown several times) so code is not a unique key
